# wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread (Resource)

Provides an Azure Active Directory authentication domain resource. This authenticates users via
SAML against Azure AD, so it depends on a `wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml` resource configured
for Azure AD's SAML endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml" "azuread" {
  authentication_name = "azuread_saml"
  idp_metadata        = file("${path.module}/azuread-federationmetadata.xml")
  timeout             = 30

  claim_customization {
    username = "email"
  }
}

resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread" "corporate" {
  domain_name          = "corporate.onmicrosoft.com"
  auth_domain_name     = "corporate-azuread"
  client_id            = "87654321-4321-4321-4321-210987654321"
  entity_id            = "https://sts.windows.net/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012/"
  label                = "Corporate Azure AD"
  default_language     = "en"
  default_email_domain = "corporate.com"
  description          = "Corporate Azure Active Directory domain"
  external_auths       = [wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.azuread.authentication_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `domain_name` (String)
- `entity_id` (String)
- `external_auths` (List of String)
- `label` (String)

### Optional

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `description` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

### Relationship to externalauth_saml

`external_auths` references one or more `wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.authentication_name`
values - Azure AD authenticates through WALLIX's generic SAML integration, configured with Azure
AD as the identity provider. `client_id` and `entity_id` should match the values from your Azure
AD app registration / SAML federation metadata.

### default_language

Must be one of `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ru`.

### Optional Certificate-Based Fields

`certificate`, `client_secret`, `private_key`, and `passphrase` are all optional. `passphrase`
requires `private_key` to also be set.

## Import

Azure AD authentication domain can be imported using the domain name, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_authdomain_azuread.corporate corporate.onmicrosoft.com
```
